findings.description: External call vault.redeem(sharesToWithdraw, address(this), address(this)) at L194 occurs before state writes clientBalances[token][client]=0 (L197) and totalDeposited[token]-=clientStoredBalance (L198). State zeroing after external interaction. Public entry (skim/totalWithdrawal path) carries nonReentrant in AYieldStrategy, so same-function reentry is blocked; flag is for cross-function/read-only reentrancy review against a malicious ERC4626 vault.

External call ammAdapter.swap(address(vault), address(underlyingToken), sharesToSell, minOut) at L231 occurs before state writes clientBalances[token][client]=0 (L234) and totalDeposited[token]-=clientStoredBalance (L235). The AMM swap routes through Curve Router NG (external, untrusted-pool surface). Cross-function reentrancy review warranted.

Return value of vault.redeem(sharesToRedeem, recipient, address(this)) at L135 is ignored. Actual assets received are not validated against an expected/min amount; a misbehaving or lossy ERC4626 vault could send fewer assets than implied while the strategy proceeds as if disposal fully succeeded. Worth a precision/accounting check by the scanner.

IERC20(_underlyingToken).approve(_erc4626Vault, type(uint256).max) return value ignored at L50. Raw approve (not safeApprove); for a non-bool-returning underlying this could silently no-op. Corroborated by Aderyn Unchecked-Return + Unsafe-ERC20-Operation at same line.

Local variable totalSetAside declared uninitialized at L317. Solidity zero-initializes by default so likely benign; flagged because it participates in buffer-distribution accumulation — verify the running sum starts at the intended base.
Local variable totalSetAside declared uninitialized at L360 (mirror of SLITHER-005 in the market strategy). Verify buffer-distribution accumulation base.

Local variable lastToken declared uninitialized at L74 inside route-configuration loop. Used to validate bidirectional/chained route token continuity; an unintended zero-address start could weaken the route-validation invariant. Verify against the bidirectional-route design decision.

Strict equality totalShares == 0 || totalDeposited[token] == 0 used as an early-return guard at L185. Dangerous-strict-equality detector; here it is an exact-zero short-circuit (not a balance-equals-threshold check) so likely intended. Listed for completeness.
Strict equality totalShares == 0 || totalDeposited[token] == 0 early-return guard at L215 (mirror of SLITHER-008).

External call vault.convertToShares(surplus) inside a loop at L290 (reached via AYieldStrategy.skimSurplus -> _skimSurplus). Per-iteration external call: gas-griefing / partial-failure surface if the client/token array is attacker-influenced. Corroborated by Aderyn Loop-Contains-require/revert at L278.
External call vault.convertToShares(surplus) inside a loop at L333 (mirror of SLITHER-010 in market strategy). Corroborated by Aderyn Loop-Contains-require/revert at L321.

Swapped event emitted (L140) after external call router.exchange(...) (L138). Event-after-external-call ordering; low impact on its own but relevant to the broader reentrancy picture of the adapter swap path used by the market strategy.

EnumerableSet add/remove return values ignored at L269/L271 (_authorizedClients). Set-membership idempotency: caller cannot detect a no-op add (already-present) or no-op remove (absent). Base-class context file; low signal but kept for access-control accounting review.

abi.encodePacked() flagged for hash-collision. Here it is only used to build a human-readable revert string (concatenating a constant message with a uint->string), not to compute a hash or signed/keyed digest. No collision-relevant security impact; downgraded and recorded for transparency. Base-class context file.

notesForScanners: PRIORITY FILE ERC4626YieldStrategy.sol (COLD): top items to reason about are SLITHER-001 (_totalWithdraw external-call-before-state-write, L194) and SLITHER-003 (_disposeShares ignores vault.redeem actual-assets return, L135). Both touch ERC4626 share<->asset conversion trust and the YS-01/story-049 fix surface.

Semgrep p/smart-contracts produced ONLY INFO-level style/perf hits on the focus files (130) — zero kept. The ruleset has no real vuln coverage for this code shape; consider augmenting with Crytic/community reentrancy rules in a future run.

Slither timestamp detector on AYieldStrategy._updateWithdrawalStatus (two-phase withdrawal window) was reviewed: it is the inherited base-class waiting/execution window, intentional time-driven logic per CLAUDE.md Law-1 note. Not normalized as a finding here (base context, prior-audited) but recall-preserved in this note.

All swap/redeem external-call sinks (SLITHER-001/002/012) feed the cross-function reentrancy question against an untrusted ERC4626 vault or Curve pool — recommend econ-scanner/code-scanner confirm the nonReentrant coverage on every public entry that reaches _totalWithdraw and _skimSurplus.
